execution_model: Paper simulation on daily bars. Donchian: signals at day t close fill at t+1 open; stops checked before channel exits; gap-through-stop fills at the bar open; channel exits fill at the next open. RSI(2): entries fill AT the signal day's close (canonical Connors); exits at the first close > SMA(5), filled at that close; NO stop. Gross numbers model no slippage/spread/commissions; net_of_friction twins deduct a fixed round-trip charge per unit. The simulator never halts for balance or margin — equity_went_negative flags a run whose paper equity dipped below $0.

spec.donchian: 20d channel entry, stop = entry -/+ 2xATR(14) (ATR at signal day), units = floor(150 / (2 x ATR x point value)), 10d opposite-channel close -> exit next open
spec.rsi2: close > SMA(200) and RSI(2) < 5 -> buy at the signal close (canonical Connors); shares = floor(3000 / signal close) ($3,000 notional = $150 budget vs a 5% adverse move); exit at first close > SMA(5); R = $150 proxy for every trade
spec.data: Yahoo raw daily OHLC via yfinance (fetch_daily_data.py); GC=F is a continuous front-month splice
